issue_context.title: API Tests Failing
issue_context.body:
<!--- This template provides sections for bugs and features. Please delete any irrelevant sections before submitting -->

#### Expected Behavior
<!--- Required. Describe the behavior you expect to see for your case. -->
All API tests pass

#### Actual Behavior
<!--- Required. Describe the actual behavior for your case. -->
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/41277998/95500923-6d47df00-095c-11eb-86eb-d6133bb68ede.png)

Basic API tests are failing when they shouldn't be. Here is my findings:

Endpoint problems:
- CreateBacktest() is failing on the CSharpProject & PythonProject test; No error
- AddProjectFile() is failing on the FSharpProject test <= The error say it doesn't support file extension?? It is a .fs file? Did we remove FSharp?
- ReadPrices() is failing for both 1Symbol and MultipleSymbols, API response has no helpful data on the problem is.

Test Problem:
- GetDividends and GetSplits tests fail because the AAPL data does not match the asserted values. Endpoint seem to be working, but values are slightly off? Maybe an adjustment to the data?
- CRUD_ProjectFiles_SucessFully : The apis return on our fake file doesn't match the code I give it, in fact the response code attribute is null. Could be endpoint issue, requires more studying. 


For the brokerage/data provider tests, maybe we should seperate them since they require configs for each API?

#### Potential Solution
<!--- Optional. Describe any potential solutions and/or thoughts as to what may be causing the difference between expected and actual behavior. -->

Go through and adjust tests, maybe separate brokerage tests for simplifying test fixtures 

#### Reproducing the Problem
<!--- Required for Bugs. Describe how to reproduce the problem. This can be via a failing unit test or a simplified algorithm that reliably demonstrates this issue.  -->

Run RestApiTests with UserId and Token
